subject: bounded N-class context-and-closure pack over a repository, its provider objects, its pinned methods, and its unavailable sources

frozen_source.note: Exact upstream blob identities are locked in intake/context-closure-engineering/source-lock.json method_references. This bundle carries no upstream bytes.

pack_role_note: File names are consumer bindings, not portable constants; --bind ROLE=FILE overrides any row.
classification_vs_authority_note: L_REFERENCE and R_REFERENCE are classification tokens describing what kind of statement an anchor is (a local- or remote-provider reference), not the promoted authority letters L/R above. A statement classified L_REFERENCE or R_REFERENCE with anchor authority N or P is the ordinary, expected shape; EVIDENCE_PROMOTION is governed by the authority field alone, per LAW-NO-PROMOTION.

edge_classes.S: start-readiness: a readable interface or fact is enough to begin bounded reversible work
edge_classes.C: completion-readiness: the predecessor must close through its own evidence lane
edge_classes.X: external dependency: another repository must expose an exact target-local fact
edge_classes.HOLD: a named source, experiment, seam, or authority is absent
edge_classes.PARALLEL: two bounded writers appear path-disjoint; not a safety proof

portable_laws.check: not mechanized here: the checker never writes provider state and holds no provider credential
CLASSIFICATION_UNKNOWN keeps EXTERNAL_CLAIM and ABSENT in the closed vocabulary

planted_negatives.probe: Remove one denominator source; the omission must remain visible.
Replace one completion edge with a start edge; completion must remain open.
Assign two active writers to one durable value; one convergence owner must be selected.
Cite the pack as completion evidence; the authority class must refuse the promotion.
Mark a predecessor landed from merge ancestry while its provider marker disagrees; the dependency gap must remain.
planted_negatives.reason: Deciding it needs an authenticated provider readback of the predecessor marker. This bundle holds no provider credential and no provider API, so a hermetic checker could only compare the pack against itself.

planted_negatives.probe: Delete the absent article/PDF row; source accounting must become incomplete.
Treat an open change with green candidate tests as provider-ready despite a failing trusted check; the transition must remain blocked.
planted_negatives.reason: Deciding it needs the provider's current check rollup for an exact head. The pack records a frozen observation of that rollup, and re-reading a frozen observation cannot detect that it went stale.

consumer_canary.reason: The consumer's outputs live in another repository and its provider lane is not owned here. A hermetic PASS in this bundle is not a consumer receipt.
